Thank you for supporting CornFIeld! 🎁

notes.title: EXTENSIVE UPDATES & FIXES
notes.content:
🔧 EXTENSIVE UPDATES & FIXES – WEEK 0📅 A new update cycle begins for The Wallway, CornField, and BloodLight.
Welcome to WEEK 0 of a brand-new development cycle at Galactic Games!

Starting now, EVERY WEEK, all three of our multiplayer horror games will receive focused updates aimed at polishing gameplay, fixing bugs, and preparing for full release.
  💀 The Wallway  🌽 CornField  🩸 BloodLight
All titles remain in Early Access, but this weekly update schedule marks the beginning of a new era. Expect steady improvements and deeper fixes every single week.
What’s coming regularly:  ⚙️ Core system optimization  🐞 Bug fixing  🗺️ Visual and level design tweaks  🌐 Multiplayer and network tuning  🔥 Feature upgrades
This is WEEK 0 – the foundation. Each coming week will bring more progress, transparency, and content.

- Team Galactic Games
